caseStudy.context: Bäbil is a university Human–Computer Interaction lab project focused on an online library application. The interface was designed in Figma and implemented with Java Swing, in a team of two with Adel Meseur.
caseStudy.role: Interface design and Java Swing application development as part of the HCI lab.
constraints: Design a clear journey for discovering and browsing an online library
Present the book-bag and payment-confirmation steps
Keep the Figma prototype and application interface aligned
approach: Structure user needs and functional requirements from the lab project brief
Design the screens and user journey in Figma
Implement the desktop application views with Java Swing
Present the journey through the library, bag and confirmation screens
caseStudy.outcome: A Figma prototype and Java Swing application presenting the key screens of an online library experience.
